reason: I'm not adding a bot to our work chats and signing it into my Google account just to sort nota. The receipts pile up, sure, but I only look when something feels off, and that has worked well enough so far.
objection: A bot from someone I don't know reading every message in my staff groups and getting into my Google Drive. Who is behind it, where does the data go, and what else can it see?
would_change_my_mind: A local owner I know telling me it caught real duplicate or padded nota for them, and a clear way to use it without sign-in to my main Google account, like a separate account or forwarding only, with the bot unable to read anything except the receipts.
